--DECLARE @Datetoprocess AS DATE='2025-10-30';
DELETE
FROM EDS.TRUST_ACCOUNT_HOLDER
WHERE AS_OF_DATE = @Datetoprocess;

DECLARE @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY AS DATE

SELECT TOP 1 @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY = FULLDATE
FROM EDS.DATE_DIM
WHERE FULLDATE < @Datetoprocess
	AND Business_Day_Flag = 'Y'
	AND FULLDATE = DATEADD(day, 1, Previous_Business_Day)
ORDER BY FULLDATE DESC;

DECLARE @PREVIOUS_BAL_BDATE AS DATE

SELECT @PREVIOUS_BAL_BDATE = PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
FROM EDS.DATE_DIM
WHERE FULLDATE = @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY;

	,TRU_INVEST
AS (
	SELECT DAT.AS_OF_DATE AS_OF_DATE
		,CUST.UNIQUE_ID CIF_ID
		,CUST.CUST_NO INTE_CIF_ID
		,BASE.CUST_NO BASE_NO
		,BASE.CUST_NO_UNMASKED BASE_NO_UNMASKED
		,BASE.LAST6_CUST_NO LAST6_BASE_NO
		,BASE.PRIMARY_FLAG
		,PORT.PORTFOLIO_NO
		,PORT.PORTFOLIO_NO_UNMASKED
		,PORT.SUBSCRIPTION_ID
		,SUBS.INCEPTION_DATE
		,CASE 
			WHEN NONUITF_PRODUCT_CODE = 'CASHEQ'
				AND NONUITF_SUB_PROD_CODE = 'TB'
				THEN SEC.MATURITY_DATE
			WHEN NONUITF_PRODUCT_CODE = 'CASHEQ'
				AND NONUITF_SUB_PROD_CODE IN (
					'SSA'
					,'BSDA'
					,'BLR'
					,'TD'
					)
				THEN NONUITF.NONUITF_MATURITY_DT
			WHEN NONUITF_PRODUCT_CODE = 'DEBT'
				AND NONUITF_SUB_PROD_CODE IN (
					'CERT'
					,'STCP'
					,'SCR'
					,'PN'
					,'BONDS'
					,'GS'
					)
				THEN SEC.MATURITY_DATE
			ELSE NULL
			END AS MATURITY_DATE
		,CASE 
			WHEN PORT.PROD_CODE = 'TUTF'
				THEN 'UITF'
			WHEN PORT.PROD_CODE <> 'TUTF'
				THEN 'NONUITF'
			END PRODUCT_GROUP
		,CASE 
			WHEN PORT.PROD_CODE = 'TUTF'
				THEN UITFPF.FUND_CD
			WHEN PORT.PROD_CODE <> 'TUTF'
				THEN PORT.PROD_CODE
			END PRODUCT_CODE
		,CASE 
			WHEN PORT.PROD_CODE = 'TUTF'
				THEN UITF.BALANCE_UNITS
			ELSE NONUITF.NONUITF_HOLDING_UNITS
			END HOLDING_UNITS
		,CASE 
			WHEN PORT.PROD_CODE = 'TUTF'
				THEN UITF.FUND_CURRENCY_CODE
			ELSE NONUITF.NONUITF_INVESTMENT_CCY
			END PRINCIPAL_VALUE_CCY
		,CON.CONVERSIONRATE
		,CASE 
			WHEN PORT.PROD_CODE = 'TUTF'
				THEN UITF.INVESTMENT_VALUE
			ELSE NONUITF.NONUITF_INVESTMENT_AMT
			END PRINCIPAL_VALUE_ORIG
		,CASE 
			WHEN PORT.PROD_CODE = 'TUTF'
				THEN UITF.INVESTMENT_VALUE
			ELSE NONUITF.NONUITF_INVESTMENT_AMT
			END OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PRN_ORIG
		,CASE 
			WHEN PORT.PROD_CODE = 'TUTF'
				THEN COALESCE(COALESCE(UITF.INVESTMENT_VALUE, 0) * (
							CASE 
								WHEN UITF.FUND_CURRENCY_CODE = 'PHP'
									THEN 1
								ELSE COALESCE(CON.CONVERSIONRATE, 0)
								END
							), 0)
			ELSE COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_INVESTMENT_AMT, 0) * (
					CASE 
						WHEN NONUITF.NONUITF_INVESTMENT_CCY = 'PHP'
							THEN 1
						ELSE COALESCE(CON.CONVERSIONRATE, 0)
						END
					)
			END PRINCIPAL_VALUE_PHP
		,CASE 
			WHEN PORT.PROD_CODE = 'TUTF'
				THEN COALESCE(COALESCE(UITF.INVESTMENT_VALUE, 0) * (
							CASE 
								WHEN UITF.FUND_CURRENCY_CODE = 'PHP'
									THEN 1
								ELSE COALESCE(CON.CONVERSIONRATE, 0)
								END
							), 0)
			ELSE COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_INVESTMENT_AMT, 0) * (
					CASE 
						WHEN NONUITF.NONUITF_INVESTMENT_CCY = 'PHP'
							THEN 1
						ELSE COALESCE(CON.CONVERSIONRATE, 0)
						END
					)
			END OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PRN_PHP
		,CASE 
			WHEN PORT.PROD_CODE = 'TUTF'
				THEN UITF.MARKET_VALUE
			ELSE NONUITF.NONUITF_CURRENT_VALUE
			END MARKET_VALUE_ORIG
		,CASE 
			WHEN PORT.PROD_CODE = 'TUTF'
				THEN UITF.MARKET_VALUE
			ELSE NONUITF.NONUITF_CURRENT_VALUE
			END OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_MKT_ORIG
		,CASE 
			WHEN PORT.PROD_CODE = 'TUTF'
				THEN COALESCE(UITF.MARKET_VALUE, 0) * (
						CASE 
							WHEN UITF.FUND_CURRENCY_CODE = 'PHP'
								THEN 1
							ELSE COALESCE(CON.CONVERSIONRATE, 0)
							END
						)
			ELSE COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_CURRENT_VALUE, 0) * (
					CASE 
						WHEN NONUITF.NONUITF_INVESTMENT_CCY = 'PHP'
							THEN 1
						ELSE COALESCE(CON.CONVERSIONRATE, 0)
						END
					)
			END MARKET_VALUE_PHP
		,CASE 
			WHEN PORT.PROD_CODE = 'TUTF'
				THEN COALESCE(UITF.MARKET_VALUE, 0) * (
						CASE 
							WHEN UITF.FUND_CURRENCY_CODE = 'PHP'
								THEN 1
							ELSE COALESCE(CON.CONVERSIONRATE, 0)
							END
						)
			ELSE COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_CURRENT_VALUE, 0) * (
					CASE 
						WHEN NONUITF.NONUITF_INVESTMENT_CCY = 'PHP'
							THEN 1
						ELSE COALESCE(CON.CONVERSIONRATE, 0)
						END
					)
			END OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_MKT_PHP
		,CASE 
			WHEN PORT.PROD_CODE = 'TUTF'
				THEN UITF.GAIN_LOSS
			ELSE (
					CASE 
						WHEN NONUITF.NONUITF_SUB_PROD_CODE IN (
								'BONDS'
								,'TB'
								,'GS'
								,'STCP'
								,'CERT'
								,'CS'
								,'PN'
								,'SCR'
								,'RE'
								,'RS'
								,'CHATTEL'
								,'PP'
								)
							THEN ((COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_HOLDING_UNITS, 0) * COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_SEC_PRICE, 0) / 100) - (COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_HOLDING_UNITS, 0) * COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_AVG_PRICE, 0) / 100))
						WHEN NONUITF.NONUITF_SUB_PROD_CODE IN (
								'CA'
								,'SA'
								)
							THEN 0
						ELSE ((COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_HOLDING_UNITS, 0) * COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_SEC_PRICE, 0)) - (COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_HOLDING_UNITS, 0) * COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_AVG_PRICE, 0)))
						END
					)
			END GAIN_LOSS_ORIG
		,CASE 
			WHEN PORT.PROD_CODE = 'TUTF'
				THEN COALESCE(UITF.GAIN_LOSS, 0) * (
						CASE 
							WHEN UITF.FUND_CURRENCY_CODE = 'PHP'
								THEN 1
							ELSE COALESCE(CON.CONVERSIONRATE, 0)
							END
						)
			ELSE (
					(
						CASE 
							WHEN NONUITF.NONUITF_SUB_PROD_CODE IN (
									'BONDS'
									,'TB'
									,'GS'
									,'STCP'
									,'CERT'
									,'CS'
									,'PN'
									,'SCR'
									,'RE'
									,'RS'
									,'CHATTEL'
									,'PP'
									)
								THEN ((COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_HOLDING_UNITS, 0) * COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_SEC_PRICE, 0) / 100) - (COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_HOLDING_UNITS, 0) * COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_AVG_PRICE, 0) / 100))
							WHEN NONUITF.NONUITF_SUB_PROD_CODE IN (
									'CA'
									,'SA'
									)
								THEN 0
							ELSE ((COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_HOLDING_UNITS, 0) * COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_SEC_PRICE, 0)) - (COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_HOLDING_UNITS, 0) * COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_AVG_PRICE, 0)))
							END
						)
					) * (
					CASE 
						WHEN NONUITF.NONUITF_INVESTMENT_CCY = 'PHP'
							THEN 1
						ELSE COALESCE(CON.CONVERSIONRATE, 0)
						END
					)
			END GAIN_LOSS_PHP
		,CASE 
			WHEN PORT.PROD_CODE = 'TUTF'
				THEN COALESCE(UITF.ROI, 0)
			ELSE COALESCE(CASE 
						WHEN NONUITF.NONUITF_SUB_PROD_CODE IN (
								'BONDS'
								,'TB'
								,'GS'
								,'STCP'
								,'CERT'
								,'CS'
								,'PN'
								,'SCR'
								,'RE'
								,'RS'
								,'CHATTEL'
								,'PP'
								)
							THEN ((COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_HOLDING_UNITS, 0) * COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_SEC_PRICE, 0) / 100.0) - (COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_HOLDING_UNITS, 0) * COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_AVG_PRICE, 0) / 100.0)) / NULLIF((COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_HOLDING_UNITS, 0) * COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_AVG_PRICE, 0) / 100.0), 0)
						WHEN NONUITF.NONUITF_SUB_PROD_CODE IN (
								'CA'
								,'SA'
								)
							THEN 0
						ELSE ((COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_HOLDING_UNITS, 0) * COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_SEC_PRICE, 0)) - (COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_HOLDING_UNITS, 0) * COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_AVG_PRICE, 0))) / NULLIF((COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_HOLDING_UNITS, 0) * COALESCE(NONUITF.NONUITF_AVG_PRICE, 0)), 0)
						END, 0)
			END ROI
